heroSubheading: We stock STIHL tools and equipment, with expert advice and local service to keep you working.
aboutHtml:
Steve and Mandy Metzger run STIHL SHOP Blenheim, your local dealer for outdoor power equipment. We stock chainsaws, lawn mowers, trimmers, blowers, battery tools, and ride-on mowers from STIHL, plus safety gear and genuine parts.

Our team has the knowledge to help you choose the right tool for the work ahead. Whether you're clearing land, maintaining your property, or tackling a big project, we can recommend what works. We also service and repair all the equipment we sell, and source genuine parts to keep your tools running well.

Pop in and chat with us about what you need. We're open Monday to Friday 8am to 5:30pm, Saturday 8:30am to 3pm, and Sunday 10am to 3pm.
